**Motif:** pin, intermezzo

**Explanation (coaching note):**
The rook on f8 is pinned to Black's king—it can't move or capture without exposing the king to check from your rook on e8. Your queen check on f7 forces the king to move (Kh8), leaving the pinned rook defenseless. You then capture it with check (Qxf8+), and Black must recapture with the bishop. You win a clean rook—the most valuable tactical motif at your level is exploiting pins. Spot a pinned piece and look for ways to pile up attacks on it while it's frozen!
